title: Branch
definition: One physical building, with its own opening hours and its own staff.
not: a branch in source control. Both appear in the same sentence often enough to be worth separating, and a reader arriving from either one will read the other as a mistake.

title: Record
definition: The description of a thing, held once and read by every system.
not: a knowledge document filed under a type — see [gls-framework.record].

title: Query
definition: What a reader typed, after parsing and before matching.
not: the request the service received. One request carries a query and its paging.

title: Record
definition: A knowledge document filed under a type, carrying frontmatter and an id.
not: every file in a type's folder. A template and a generated index are neither. The catalogue uses the word for something else again — see [gls-estate].
